bambu.title: Bambu Lab
bambu.rowSubtitle: Connect your account for live status

connect.heading: Connect your Bambu Lab account
connect.intro: Paste your access token once. PrintOS never asks for your Bambu password and only reads status and print history. It cannot control your printer.
connect.guideTitle: Where do I find the access token?
connect.step1: Sign in at bambulab.com in your browser.
connect.step2: Open the developer tools of your browser (F12) and go to Application or Storage, then Cookies.
connect.step3: Select https://bambulab.com and copy the value of the cookie named token.
connect.step4: Paste it below. It stays on the server, encrypted, and is never shown again.
connect.guideNote: This is an unofficial method and Bambu Lab can change it. The token expires after a while; then you paste a new one.
connect.tokenHint: Treat it like a password. Do not share it.
